eyebrow.zh: 本地签名、可离线验签的写作过程存证。
eyebrow.en: Locally signed, offline-verifiable provenance for your writing process.

headline.zh: 被 AIGC 检测误判时，递出去的是可机器复核的写作过程回执。
headline.en: When a detector calls your writing AI-made, hand over a machine-checkable receipt.

sub.zh: 每次保存进入 ed25519 哈希链，草稿一个字节都不出本机；学位办用同一二进制离线验签：未动 PASS，改一个字符立即 FAIL。
sub.en: Every save joins an ed25519 hash chain and no draft byte ever leaves the machine; the degree office verifies offline with the same binary — PASS intact, FAIL on any edit.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方演示。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 检测器给分数，humanizer 教你藏；DraftProof 输出密码学可验的写作过程证据。
body.en: Detectors emit scores and humanizers teach evasion; DraftProof emits cryptographically verifiable process evidence.

body.zh: 回执只含哈希与元数据；密钥与快照全部留在本地，零网络。
body.en: Receipts carry hashes and metadata only; keys and snapshots stay local, zero network.

body.zh: 学位办拿到 .dpb 后离线运行 draftproof verify，篡改即翻红并定位断点。
body.en: The degree office runs draftproof verify offline; tampering flips it red with a breakpoint.

body.zh: 知网/维普等 AIGC 检测的分数可能卡住答辩与发表，而“这论文是我自己写的”无法自证。DraftProof 把写作期间每次保存变成带时间戳的签名快照，把“我写了多久、改了多少版”变成第三方可独立复核的证据。
body.en: A mandatory AIGC-detector score can block a defense or a submission, and "I wrote this myself" is unfalsifiable from the reviewer's side. DraftProof turns every save during writing into a signed, timestamped snapshot, making the process independently checkable.

body.zh: watch 监听论文目录，任何编辑器的保存（防抖去重）都追加一条 ed25519 签名快照；export 打包 .dpb 回执与可打印 HTML 时间线；verify 离线复核，篡改即 FAIL 并定位断点。
body.en: watch listens on the thesis directory and appends an ed25519-signed snapshot for every editor save (debounced, deduplicated); export bundles a .dpb receipt plus a printable HTML timeline; verify re-checks offline and localizes any tamper breakpoint.

alt.zh: 四段流程：init 生成密钥卡并预登记；watch 捕获每次保存进哈希链；export 导出回执；verify 离线复核，篡改即 FAIL。
alt.en: Four stages: init issues the key card for pre-registration; watch captures each save into the hash chain; export emits the receipt; verify re-checks offline and fails on tampering.

body.zh: 单进程 Go 二进制，全程离线：fsnotify 捕获保存事件，快照（时间戳、字节哈希、大小、prev_hash）逐条 ed25519 签名后追加进 append-only 的 .draftproof/chain.jsonl；回执包再由作者密钥整体签名。
body.en: A single offline Go binary: fsnotify catches saves; each snapshot (timestamps, byte hash, size, prev_hash) is ed25519-signed and appended to the append-only .draftproof/chain.jsonl; the receipt envelope is signed again by the author key.

alt.zh: 作者本机：编辑器保存经 fsnotify 进入 append-only 哈希链；export 生成 .dpb 与 HTML；学位办侧同一二进制离线 verify。
alt.en: On the author's machine, editor saves flow through fsnotify into an append-only hash chain; export produces .dpb and HTML; the reviewer side verifies offline with the same binary.

body.zh: 按字节哈希记录 .docx/.md/.tex，不解析内部结构、不改写一个字；本地时间戳 + 单调时钟，密钥卡预登记对抗“换钥匙重造”；云端时间戳与区块链锚定明确不在 v0.1。
body.en: Byte-hashed capture of .docx/.md/.tex without parsing or rewriting; local timestamps plus a monotonic clock, with key-card pre-registration against key-swap rebuilds; cloud timestamps and blockchain anchoring are explicitly out of v0.1.

alt.zh: 中心是按字节哈希的快照链，环绕编辑器（Word/WPS/Typora/VS Code）、命令（init/watch/log/export/verify）、产物（.dpb/.html/密钥卡）与边界（仅本地、不上云）。
alt.en: The byte-hash snapshot chain sits at the center, ringed by editors (Word/WPS/Typora/VS Code), commands (init/watch/log/export/verify), artifacts (.dpb/.html/key card) and the boundary (local only, no cloud).

body.zh: 作者端五条命令：init / watch / log / export / verify。作者端 CLI 与回执永久免费；裁决侧（学位办/期刊编辑部）的批量验签工作站是 v0.2+ 的付费方向。
body.en: Five commands on the author side: init / watch / log / export / verify. The author CLI and receipts stay free; the reviewer-side batch verification workstation is the paid v0.2+ direction.

body.zh: 回执证明过程存在且导出后未被篡改，不证明“没有使用 AI”；本地时间戳防不了换钥匙整链重造，所以密钥卡要在写作前发给导师留档。
body.en: A receipt proves the process existed and was not altered after export; it does not prove AI was unused. Local timestamps cannot stop a key-swap rebuild, which is why the key card must be pre-registered before writing.

note.zh: 真实命令与输出，全程离线：捕获四次保存、导出回执、verify PASS，篡改一个快照后 verify FAIL 并定位断点。完整记录见 docs/demo-results.json。
note.en: Real commands and output, fully offline: four saves captured, receipt exported, verify PASS, then one snapshot tampered and verify FAIL with a breakpoint. Full record in docs/demo-results.json.

body.zh: 同一份回执：未动 → PASS；把 seq 2 的 content_hash 改 8 个字符 → 签名与链同时断裂，断点定位到具体快照。
body.en: Same receipt: intact → PASS; flip 8 chars of seq 2's content_hash → signature and chain both break, with the breakpoint named.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+（或直接下载 Release 单文件二进制）。示例脚本在临时目录完成全流程，不触碰真实论文。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+ (or grab a single-binary release). The example runs the whole loop in a temp directory and never touches a real thesis.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/draftproof.git
cd draftproof
go build -o bin/draftproof .

title.zh: 挂到你自己的论文目录
title.en: Point it at your own thesis

limitations.zh: 回执证明写作过程存在且导出后未被篡改，不证明“没有使用 AI”；AI 协作会话在 Skill 模式下会被如实标记。
limitations.en: A receipt proves the process existed and was not altered after export; it does not prove AI was unused. AI-assisted sessions are honestly labeled in skill mode.

limitations.zh: 本地时间戳防不了“换钥匙整链重造”——密钥卡预登记（写作前发导师留档）是信任模型的关键环节。
limitations.en: Local timestamps cannot stop a key-swap rebuild — key-card pre-registration (sent to an advisor before writing) is the key mitigation.
